release_notes:
Add DhruFusion-compatible API and fix reseller order syncing

- New: your site now also speaks the DhruFusion API standard, alongside
  the existing GSM Fusion API, at a new /dhrufusion_api web address.
  Existing DhruFusion-based panels and scripts can connect with no code
  changes, using the same account and API key you already have. Includes
  bulk actions for placing or checking up to 100 orders in one request.
- Fix: Server orders placed through a connected DhruFusion supplier were
  failing immediately instead of going through.
- Fix: Server order results from a connected DhruFusion supplier were
  never being checked, so an order could sit "in process" forever even
  after the supplier had finished it.
- Security: closed a gap that let a restricted admin account open the
  Settings page directly by web address, bypassing their permissions.
- Security: closed a gap that allowed a request to change site email and
  notification settings without being logged in.
- The customer "API Settings" page now shows both API web addresses
  with plain-language setup steps, and a cleaner view of the IP
  address(es) connected to your API key.
- Updated the API documentation (PDF) and sample code download to cover
  both APIs.
